// diagnostic E2912

Jet.DerivedReturnsNothing

`reactive.derived` must compute and return a value.

What

`reactive.derived` must compute and return a value.

Why

A derived value is recomputed from its signals, so its lambda has to return the new value. A body that returns nothing is a side effect, not a value.

Fix

Return a value from the body, or use `reactive.autorun(fn() { … })` for a side effect.
